entities.name: Bernhard Lösener
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bernhard Lösener was a lawyer and "expert" on Jewish matters in the Reich Ministry of the Interior. He was among the lawyers who helped draft the Nuremberg Laws, among other legislation that deprived German Jews of their rights and ultimately led to their deportation to concentration camps.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bernhard Lösener was a lawyer and "expert" on Jewish matters in the Reich Ministry of the Interior. He was among the lawyers who helped draft the Nuremberg Laws, among other legislation that deprived German Jews of their rights and ultimately led to their deportation to concentration camps.
